paite: Huai lou leng Ahithophel in Absalom kiang ah, "Mi singkhat-le-sangnih ka telkhe dia, tuzan in David delh ding in ka kuan ding.
heading: Hushai In Absalom Apikhial

paite: Abah lai leh hat louh laitak ka va phanon dia, ka va lausak ding. Huchi in akiang a mi tengteng ataimang ding uh. Huchi in kumpipa kia ka va that mai ding.
Na kiang ah mipite ka hon pikik nawn vek ding. Na mizonpa mi tengteng hong kik toh kibang ahi. Huchi in mi tengteng khamuang in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
Huan hiai thugen in Absalom leh Israel upate akipaksak hi.
Huchi in Absalom in, "Arki mi Hushai sam peuhmah phot inla, amah gendan i ngaikhe peuhmah ding uh," achi hi.
Absalom kiang a Hushai ahong tun in Absalom in, "Ahithophel in hichibang in agen a, agen bang a hih ding i ding uam? Hih lou ding hi leng nang hon gen himhim dih," chi in ana houpih hi.
Hushai in Absalom kiang ah, "Tutung a Ahithophel lemtheihna ahoih kei," achi hi.
Hushai in, "Na pa leh amite na thei a, sepaih hangsantak, gam a vompi anou laksak bang mai ahi uh. Na pa lah galdoumi ahi a, mipi lak ah agiak khol kei ding.

Ngai in, tu in leng koi lai leihawm hiam ah, koi lai mun ah hiam a kibu ahi ding. Huan hichi ahi ding a, akisual tung ua mi khenkhat apuk ualeh aza peuh in, Absalom zuite athat ek uh, achi mai ding uh.

Huchi in mihangsantak, humpinelkai lungsim bang pumi hial leng ahong lungke mahmah ding uh. Israel mi tengteng in lah na pa sepaih hangsantak ahihdan leh akiang a mi omte mihangsan taktak ahihdan uh athei vek ngal ua.
Kei hoihsak sam dan, Israel mi tengteng Dan a pan Beer-sheba pha in tuipi a piaunel zah hial ding na kiang ah samkhawm vek lehang; kidouna ah nang nangawn kuan lechin.
Huchi in koi lai mun peuh ah i kituahna na ah lei a daitui kia bang mai in i boh ding ua; amah leh akiang a mi om tengteng khat lel leng i hawi kei ding uh.
Huai lou leng, khua a alutleh Israel mi tengteng, khauhual tawi in huai ah i va hoh ding ua, suang neuchik leng om lou hial khop in lui ah i kaikhe vek ding," achi hi.

Huchi in Absalom leh Israel mi tengteng in, "Ahithophel thuhilhna sang in Arka mi Hushai thuhilhna ahoihzaw," achi uhi. TOUPA'N Absalom tung a thil hoih lou atunsak theihna ding in Ahithophel thuhilhna hoihtak nuaisiah ding in ana sep khin him hi.

Huchi in Hushai in siampu Zadok leh Abiathar kiang ah, "Huchibang khachibang in Ahithophel in Absalom leh Israel upate hoih ding in angaihtuahpih a; ke'n huchibang khachibang in hoih ding in ka ngaihtuah hi.
heading: David Hilhkholh In A-om A, Asuakta

paite: Huaiziak in tuzan in gamdai lui kainate a giak nawn lou in kan ngeingei un. Huchi lou in zaw kumpipa leh akiang a om tengteng ahihmang vek kha ding uh chi in David hilhsak zok un," achi hi.
Khopi sung alut uh kuama'n amuhlouhna ding un, Jonathan leh Ahimaaz bel En-rogel ah a-om ua; sikhanu khat in amaute ava hilh zel hi. Amau kumpipa David ava hilhsawn zel uhi.
Himahleh naupang in ana mu a, Absalom ahilh hi. Himahleh anih un ataimang pah ua, Bahurim a mi khat, a-intual a tuileh nei inn ah ava hoh ua, tuileh sung ah alutsukta uhi.
Numei in tuileh asitna in asin a, atung ah buh aphou a, kuama'n athei kei hi.

Absalom sikhate numei kiang ah ava hoh ua, "Ahimaaz leh Jonathan koi a om ahi ua?" achi uhi. Numei in akiang uah, "Luita tui akanta ding uh," ana chi hi. Ava zong ua, amu kei ua, Jerusalem ah akik nawn uh.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, apaitum khit un tuileh a pan ahong pawtkhia ua, kumpipa David ava hilh uhi. David kiang ah, "Pawtkhia unla, tui kan pah un, huchi in Ahithophel in ahon tum hi," achi uh.
Huchi in David leh akiang a mi om tengteng apawtkhia ua, Jordan lui akan uh. Khua ahong vak in Jordan lui kan lou khat lel leng a-om kei uh.

Ahithophel in ahoihsakdan azui kei uh, chih atheih in asabiltung avan a, apawtkhia a, akhua ah apai hi. A-inkuante khosakna ding abawlsak sipsip a, huchi in a-awklumta hi. Amah asita a, apa han ah avui uhi.
Huchi in David, Mahanaim ava tung hi. Absalom in akiang a Israel mi tengteng toh Jordan lui akan uhi.
Absalom in Joab sik in Amasa sepaih heutu ding in akoih hi. Amasa bel mi khat amin Ithra tapa ahi. Ithra ahihleh Israel mi, Joab nu sanggam Nahash tanu Abigail zi a neipa ahi.
Israel mite leh Absalom in Gilead gam ah panmun akhoh uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mahanaim a David atun in, Ammon suan Rabbah a mi Nahash tapa Shobi, Lo-debar a mi Amiel tapa Makir leh Rogelim a Gilead mi Barzillaite'n
lupnate, maiphiat kuangte, leibelte, huit buh, barli buh, tangbuang, be kankeu,
khuaizu, mokhon, belamte, ganhon a pan nawikhalte, David leh akiang a om mite nek ding ahon tawi uhi, "Gamdai ah mite agilkial ua, atawl ua, adangtak uh," achih ziak un.
